def sm(a,b,x):
 t=min(1.,max(0.,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t)
old=ns['bank'];bank=old.copy();bank.data=old.data.copy();ns['retire'](old);old.name='F16 bank before access ramp';bank.name='M14 continuous sculpted shore bank';craft.objects.link(bank)

 w=sm(4.20,4.47,x)*(1-sm(7.25,8.0,x))*sm(.80,1.46,y)*(1-sm(2.92,4.05,y))
 target=1.595-.182*max(0,x-4.5)
 v.co.z=z+(target-z)*w
 changes.append(float(v.co.z-z));influence.append(w)

 c=np.array(c);return np.where(c<=.04045,c/12.92,((c+.055)/1.055)**2.4)
pathcolor=linear(np.array([166,151,118])/255)
if ca:
 for li,loop in enumerate(me.loops):
  w=influence[loop.vertex_index]*.62
  c=np.array(ca.data[li].color[:3]);ca.data[li].color=(*(c*(1-w)+pathcolor*w),1)

for p in me.polygons:p.use_smooth=True

for p in stone.polygons:
 axis=max(range(3),key=lambda i:abs(p.normal[i]))
 for li in p.loop_indices:

  uv.data[li].uv=(v.x*.28,v.y*.28) if axis==2 else ((v.y if axis==0 else v.x)*.28,v.z*.28)

 lo=[min(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)];hi=[max(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)]
